findingEvidence.R2F3-1: AcceptDeliverableHandler first-accept path calls validateAuthoritativeSubmission strictly after CAS status/version gates and before the first aggregate save: exact 1-initialized + 1-submitted action count, evidence IDs/count match, no duplicate natural keys, link ID/scope/actor/time canonicality, and per-asset availability re-check. Regression test R2F3-1 covers delete-link and equal-count replace-link on both backends; aggregate stays submitted/version 2 with only 2 actions and no event/outbox/receipt residue.
findingEvidence.R2F3-2: SqlitePersistence v12 schema validation reads PRAGMA index_list partial flag and requires partial=0 for uq_deliverable_requirements_key and uq_deliverable_evidence_natural_key; regression test R2F3-2 replaces each target UNIQUE with a same-column partial unique index and asserts reopen fails closed ("must cover the full table").
findingEvidence.R2F3-3: CAS contention evidence uses two SqlitePersistence connections with distinct testExecutionId lock keys (cas-conn-1 / cas-conn-2) so they do NOT share the in-process pathLocks map; only the SQLite database CAS decides the winner. Evidence lives in tests/deliverable-evidence.test.ts section 4 of R2F2-4/5: exactly one of the two same-version submits succeeds, the loser fails closed with DELIVERABLE_VERSION_CONFLICT or SQLite busy, and no duplicate evidence link or submitted action is created.
findingEvidence.R2F3-4: Realistic v11 fixture built by seeding a full v12 database through SqlitePersistence with v11-valid representative data (principals, memberships, node with application-path leader assignment at v2, asset), then stripping the three v12 deliverable tables/indexes and the schema_migrations v12 row to produce a genuine max-version-11 database. Reopening via createTestSqliteBundle upgrades v11 to v12, preserves all v11 rows, allows a full init+submit scenario, and a second reopen re-verifies deliverable facts. A v11-style reader rejects the upgraded DB with SQLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED:12.
